cards.design_implication: Designers may consider cryo-electron tomography with subtomogram averaging as a potential method for achieving high-resolution in situ structural data for specific macromolecular targets, contingent on the target's observability and suitability for the method.
does_not_establish: Eligibility criteria for study participants or samples.
cards.evidence_excerpt: Cryo-electron tomography combined with subtomogram averaging demonstrated the power to solve such structures in situ at resolutions in the range of 3 Angstrom for some macromolecules.
limitations: The resolution range applies specifically to 'some macromolecules' rather than all observable macromolecules.
The claim is restricted to in situ structural determination capabilities.
cards.statement: Cryo-electron tomography combined with subtomogram averaging has been demonstrated to resolve structures of certain macromolecules in situ at resolutions up to 3 Angstrom.
